info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes API provides access to detailed routes for rideshare rides, enabling users to plan and optimize their travel. This API allows developers to retrieve information regarding rideshare routes, which can enhance applications focused on transportation and navigation. Typical consumers include rideshare companies, travel planners, and navigation service providers. By utilizing this API, businesses can improve user experience and delivery efficiency related to rideshare services.

get.summary: Retrieve the optimal route for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the best route for their ride based on the provided parameters. It takes into account factors such as distance, traffic, and estimated time of arrival to provide an optimized route.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve route information for rides. Ensure you provide all necessary parameters to get the desired route details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the ride route information.
